## Dictate Prompt
- The Dictate Prompt card can now be dragged from anywhere except its instruction field, matching the floating pill, and shows the same drag grip in its footer. The Read Aloud scrubber keeps its own drag behavior.

## Other
- Updated the contact address to mail@magnus-goedde.de.

## Installation
Download the DMG from the [releases page](https://github.com/mgsgde/whisper-shortcut/releases), open it, and drag WhisperShortcut to your Applications folder.

**Full changelog:** https://github.com/mgsgde/whisper-shortcut/compare/v9.10...v9.11
